summary: Froze CHGR-001 v1.0 -> v1.1 as an additive minor revision (docs/contracts/CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md Sec.26, CHGR-REQ-194 through CHGR-REQ-206), per Phase 146A's own recommendation and explicit human authorization to close the disclosed 14-of-19-field schema-conformance gap in the Publication Coordinator's human_governance_record output. Independently reconstructed the contract from direct re-reading of CHGR-001 v1.0, PEC-001 v1.1 Sec.20 (the direct structural template this revision follows), IWPC-001 v1.4 Sec.31, the frozen CHGR schema family (Phase 143E: human_governance_record.schema.json and its shared $defs), manifest.json, and the current implementation (record.py, coordinator.py, publication_handoff/handoff.py, interactive_workflow/models/session.py) rather than restating 146A's own architecture summary. Found two things 146A's own narrative did not make explicit: (1) a fourth artifact family, governance_record_integrity, is required by the already-frozen schema's integrity_ref field but was not separately named in 146A's own analysis; (2) assurance_level is mechanically derivable today from decision_maker_identity_evidence.evidence_kind (already flowing through PublicationReadinessPackage via PublicationHandoff.build_package), independent of the eligible_authority citation authority_basis_claimed genuinely still requires -- so this freeze splits the two fields 146A grouped together, a disclosed, reasoned narrowing of 146A's own scoping, not a silent reinterpretation, and does not touch the IWPC-001 Sec.31 C-1 deferral. Resolved all four open design questions from 146A Sec.4.5: sub-structure identity (four independently identified artifacts, per the schema's own already-frozen structure), digest computation (the existing SHA-256/canonical-JSON compute_record_digest algorithm, extended unchanged), lifecycle-state assignment (fixed to 'published' at construction, since Confirmation already occurs upstream of the Coordinator and no other lifecycle-transition capability exists), and the conformance-verification mechanism (fail-closed, construction-time, per docs/ROADMAP.md's Fail-closed principle). Contract-freeze only: no production code, schema, or runtime file modified; no implementation authorized or performed. See docs/PHASE_146B_CHGR001_SCHEMA_ENVELOPE_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md.
